verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal clearly accepts in-person payments, and its docs explicitly cover contactless acceptance via Tap to Pay on iPhone and Android, with PIN entry supported. The evidence never explicitly names EMV chip-insert acceptance or Apple Pay / Google Pay wallet support, so only part of the story is documented. Missing for 10: explicit chip (EMV dip) acceptance documentation, explicit Apple Pay/Google Pay mobile-wallet support, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can accept chip, contactless, and mobile-wallet (Apple Pay / Google Pay) payments in person

citations.quote: Stripe Terminal allows businesses to accept in-person payments.
Accept contactless payments using a compatible iPhone or Android device with the Stripe Terminal SDK.
Use Tap to Pay on iPhone to accept in-person contactless payments with a compatible iPhone.
Accept in-person payments on a compatible reader using Stripe's no-code solution.
